goal: Prevent nodes on high-latency links from repeatedly evicting active peers during headers presync
Avoid discarding headers sync progress when round trips take longer than the eviction timeout
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now; nothing is known that would invalidate a review.
agreement: No reviewers have formally approved yet, but initial objections have been addressed.
Addressed objection that stalled peers could hold outbound slots indefinitely (cyb3ralbert)
Addressed objection that renewals were unbounded and ignored redownload progress (cyb3ralbert)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it stops nodes on high-latency networks like Tor and I2P from dropping active sync peers.
Nodes currently discard all headers sync progress if 480 round trips take more than 22 minutes.
